name: meme-deepfake-triage
description: Dedicated visual disinformation pipeline: Multimodal VLM reasoning, deepfake indicators, adaptive debunk generation.

steps.name: fetch-asset
steps.prompt_template: Fetch and cache visual asset at URL: {{input.asset_url}}. Return asset_hash (SHA256) and local_path.

steps.name: metadata-parsing
steps.prompt_template: Extract C2PA cryptographic provenance and invisible watermarks (SynthID) for asset at {{cached_asset.local_path}}.

steps.name: vlm-forensics
steps.prompt_template: Perform multimodal forensic analysis on image at {{cached_asset.local_path}} with metadata: {{metadata_result}}. Evaluate visual reasoning, OCR, frequency domain artifacts, and deepfake indicators. Output structured JSON with visual_verdict (e.g. MANIPULATED), reasoning, and confidence.

steps.name: generate-overlay
steps.prompt_template: Using nano-banana-pro skill, generate an adaptive factcheck overlay for {{cached_asset.local_path}} based on verdict: {{visual_analysis}}. Save to output/visual/overlays/{{cached_asset.asset_hash}}.png. Return overlay_path.

steps.name: escalate-to-inquisitor
steps.prompt_template: Investigate claim embedded in visual asset. Visual analysis: {{visual_analysis}}. Source URL: {{input.source_url}}. Provide full verdict.

steps.name: deliver-visual-debunk
steps.prompt_template: Publish visual debunk. Verdict: {{inquisitor_verdict}}. Overlay image: {{overlay_result.overlay_path}}. Draft post using humanizer skill.
